provenance.instrument: New Hanover Township Zoning Ordinance (Chapter 27 Zoning, Ord. of 3-29-1990, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 NE2408, Township of New Hanover, Montgomery County. Chapter 27 was adopted 3-29-1990 and amended many times, most recently in 27-305 by Ord. No. 25-03, 25-04, 25-05 (2025) and 25-08 (12-4-2025). New Laws lists 19 items adopted in 2026, all resolutions or ordinances on bonds and plan approval, none on zoning. The Table of Use Regulations (Attachment 1) is a PDF that was not opened. Each district part lists its uses and its area and dimensional figures in the text, and those were read. Part 16 (HI) was repealed by Ord. No. 22-06 (6-2-2022)
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360: 'Includes legislation through 01-15-2026.' New Laws: 19 items, none on zoning
checks: The zoning chapter has no accessory dwelling unit, in-law suite or similar use for a house lot

'A use not listed in Part 4, R-2 Residential District, through Part 16, HI Heavy Industrial District ... is not permitted in the specific zoning district' (27-302.4). 'On any property, parcel or tract of land, only one use shall be permitted and accessory uses specifically permitted under 27-305' (27-301)
A detached dwelling is 'A single detached dwelling unit on an individual lot' (27-202, 27-305.2A)

Residential conversion: 'The conversion of an existing principal building into two or more dwelling units' is a special exception in R-2, R-2M, R-25, R-15, R-5 and RV and a permitted use in VMU. Each unit needs the district's detached dwelling lot area, the property must have been lived in for at least seven years, the house keeps a single front entrance and its outside look, and each unit needs two parking spaces (27-305.2H, 27-1916)

A 'dwelling in combination' is 'An accessory dwelling unit that is clearly subordinate to an institutional, commercial, consumer service or office use'. It is permitted in CC and VMU and a special exception in R-25, R-15, R-5 and LI. It is not a unit beside a house (27-305.6GG)
A farm unit is a detached dwelling for the owner, the owner's immediate family or farm workers, accessory to a farm, at 20 acres per unit and at most one owner unit and one tenant house (27-305.1H)
A boarder may live in the house, but 'No separate cooking facilities or dwelling unit may be created' (27-305.2J(6))

A detached accessory building for a house stands behind the house, at least 5 ft from the side and rear lines on a lot of 25,000 sq ft or less and 12 ft on a larger lot, never in the required front yard (27-1908). Garages may total 1,200 sq ft and sheds 600 sq ft (27-305.2J(1), (3))

27-306 gives a determination and special exception path for dwelling types the chapter does not list. The landowner asks the Board of Supervisors and the Planning Commission to decide whether the type falls within a use class, and the use is then permitted by special exception in the districts 27-306.1C names. Those districts are reserved, or are the repealed HI district, so no district is open to this path
A lot of record smaller than the minimum may hold a detached dwelling if it is at least one acre in R-2 and R-2M and 80% of the minimum elsewhere, with stricter yard and coverage rules (27-2209)
No section read bars a use variance. Variances need the five findings of 27-2606.3
Off-street parking: two spaces for a detached dwelling of three bedrooms or less (27-1916)

A D5 golf course-residential community, 'A planned development which combines residential uses with a golf course', is a use by right in R-25 (27-602.1M). It may include twins and duplexes, at most 0.85 dwelling units per acre (27-305.4E). It is a development of a whole tract, not a second unit on a house lot. Its tract minimum was not read
provenance.notes: Zoning office: New Hanover Township, Zoning Officer. Read in a browser on eCode360, one page at a time, on 2026-11-15, in print view. Searched the code for accessory dwelling, in-law, accessory apartment, accessory suite, ECHO, elder cottage, granny, carriage house, tenant house, second dwelling, caretaker, farm dwelling, relative, family member, living quarters and two-family. The search did not surface the F32 'accessory dwelling unit' text, which was found by reading 27-305. Read: Part 2 (definitions), Parts 4 to 9, 14, 15, 16 and 17 (every district's use list and figures), Part 19 and 27-2209. Read in part: Part 3 (27-301 to 27-304, 27-306, and in 27-305 the agricultural and residential uses A1 to B11, F22 to F24, F32 to F34), Part 22 and Part 26 (27-2605, 27-2606). Not read: Part 1, Part 18 (oil and gas), Parts 20, 21, 23 to 25, 27 to 29, the rest of 27-305 and the PDF attachments (Table of Use Regulations, zoning map). 27-403.2 sets 10% building coverage for a detached dwelling in R-2, while the 27-305.2A(2) table shows 15%. Height is measured at the front of the building to the mean height of the highest roof. Read later on 2026-11-15: 27-602 and 27-603 (R-25), and part of 27-305.4E (D5). 27-603.1 says '35 feet and 2 1/2 stories'. 27-703.1 (R-15) says 'whichever is greater', so no story limit is stored for R-15.
provenance.code_caution: 27-104 still names a TN Traditional Neighborhood, a CB-2 Commercial Business and an HI Heavy Industrial district, but the chapter gives none of them a use list. Part 12 is reserved and Part 16 (HI) was repealed. The zoning map is a PDF that was not checked. If the map still shows TN or CB-2, a lot there has no use list to read. Ask the zoning officer

term.note: Searched the code for accessory dwelling, in-law, accessory apartment, accessory suite, ECHO, elder cottage, granny, carriage house, tenant house, second dwelling, caretaker, farm dwelling, relative, family member, living quarters and two-family, and read every district's use list. The only 'accessory dwelling unit' is the dwelling in combination, which is accessory to a business or institution, not to a house

status.note: No district lists a second dwelling unit beside a house. A use not listed is not permitted (27-302.4), and a lot holds one principal use (27-301). A use variance is still a path to ask for

path.note: A second unit beside a house is not a listed use. The Zoning Hearing Board hears variances on the five findings of 27-2606.3. No section read bars a use variance. A conversion of the house into two units is a special exception in most residential districts (see the alternatives)

value.name: Residential conversion of an existing house into two units (R-2, R-2M, R-5, RV)
value.conditions: 'The conversion of an existing principal building into two or more dwelling units' (27-305.2H). The house keeps the look of a detached dwelling with a single front entrance, other entrances on the side or rear, no major outside change, separate cooking and sanitary facilities for each unit, at least 400 sq ft for an efficiency and 500 sq ft for one bedroom, a 200 sq ft patio for each unit outside the front yard and required yards, parking to the side or rear, two spaces per unit. 'A minimum lot area requirement for Use B1 Detached Dwelling shall be met for each dwelling unit', and 'A property must be residentially occupied for at least seven years before it is converted'

requires.condition: The property has been lived in for at least seven years

value.note: A special exception from the Zoning Hearing Board. The lot needs twice the detached dwelling lot area. In R-2M that is twice 50,000 sq ft, and only on an existing tract of four acres or less (a parcel that held a single-family dwelling when the chapter took effect). Other R-2M lots need twice 87,120 sq ft

value.name: Residential conversion of an existing house into two units (R-25, R-15)
value.conditions: 'The conversion of an existing principal building into two or more dwelling units' (27-305.2H). The same standards as in the other residential districts: single front entrance, no major outside change, separate kitchens and baths, minimum unit sizes, a patio per unit, two parking spaces per unit, the detached dwelling lot area for each unit and seven years of residential use first

min_lot_by_utility.when: with municipal sewer and municipal or community water

requires.condition: The property has been lived in for at least seven years

value.note: A special exception from the Zoning Hearing Board. The lot needs twice the detached dwelling lot area: 15,000 sq ft per unit with public sewer and water, 25,000 sq ft without

value.name: Residential conversion in the Village Mixed-Use district (VMU)
value.conditions: Residential conversion is a permitted use on existing tracts of less than five acres where township sewer and water are available (27-1702.1A(1)(h)). The standards of 27-305.2H apply, including seven years of residential use first. Principal buildings built before 1940 must be kept unless only single-family detached homes are built (27-1706.1B(1))

requires.condition: The property has been lived in for at least seven years

value.note: 27-305.2H(11) asks for the detached dwelling lot area for each unit. In VMU a detached dwelling needs 10,000 sq ft per dwelling unit (27-1704), so two units likely need 20,000 sq ft. The VMU part does not say this itself. Ask the zoning officer

value.name: Dwelling in combination with a business or institution (CC, VMU)
value.conditions: 'An accessory dwelling unit that is clearly subordinate to an institutional, commercial, consumer service or office use' permitted in the district. It meets the residential conversion standards on outside appearance, septic approval, separate cooking and sanitary facilities, parking buffers, trash, minimum unit size and parking (27-305.6GG)
value.note: The host is a business, office or institution, not a house

requires.condition: The lot's principal use is an institutional, commercial, consumer service or office use permitted in the district (or a nonconforming one)

value.name: Dwelling in combination with a business or institution (R-25, R-15, R-5, LI)
value.conditions: 'An accessory dwelling unit that is clearly subordinate to an institutional, commercial, consumer service or office use' permitted in the district, or a nonconforming one. 'In the R-25, R-15, LI and HI Districts, not more than one dwelling in combination shall be accessory to a principal nonresidential use' (27-305.6GG(3))
value.note: A special exception from the Zoning Hearing Board. The host is a business, office or institution, not a house

requires.condition: The lot's principal use is an institutional, commercial, consumer service or office use permitted in the district (or a nonconforming one)

value.name: Farm unit for family or farm workers (R-2, R-2M, R-25, R-15, R-5, LI)
value.conditions: 'Detached dwelling units for the sole use of the property owner, immediate family members of the property owner and persons engaged in agricultural employment on the property', limited to parents, grandparents, siblings, sons and daughters. Accessory to general farming, a nursery, intensive agriculture, a riding academy or a commercial kennel. 'Minimum lot area: 20 acres per unit', at most one unit for the owner or family and one tenant house, the detached dwelling yards, two parking spaces per unit (27-305.1H)

requires.condition: The lot's principal use is a farm, nursery, riding academy or commercial kennel

value.note: Read as 40 acres for the owner's unit and a tenant house, at 20 acres per unit

value.name: Twins or duplexes in a performance standard development (R-15)
value.conditions: A performance standard development may include twins and duplexes at 4,000 sq ft of lot per unit, on a site of at least 10 acres, at most four units per acre, at least 35% open space, with township sewer and water (27-305.2B)
value.note: A development of a whole tract, not a second unit on one house lot

value.name: Twin or duplex (VMU)
value.conditions: On existing tracts of less than five acres with township sewer and water, twins and duplexes are permitted at 5,000 sq ft of lot per unit, 40 ft wide, side yards 12 ft, rear yard 25 ft, building coverage 25%, impervious cover 40% (27-1702.1A, 27-1704, 27-1705)
value.note: Read as 10,000 sq ft for a building of two units. Whether an existing house may become a duplex this way, rather than as a residential conversion, is not said

districts_read_no_listing.note: CC lists no house. LI lists a farm unit but no house. VMU permits detached houses, twins, duplexes, townhouses, apartments and conversions but no unit beside a house. Part 16 (HI) was repealed

types_allowed.note: No ADU use beside a house. A boarder may not have separate cooking facilities or a dwelling unit (27-305.2J(6))

front_yard_barred.note: No accessory building in the required front yard, and a detached accessory building for a house 'must be behind (to the rear) of the principal building'

value.note: Detached accessory buildings for a house on a lot of 25,000 sq ft or less
On all other lots, more than 25,000 sq ft

accessory_rear_yard_only.note: A detached accessory building for a house 'must be behind (to the rear) of the principal building'

spaces_required.note: No ADU use. A detached dwelling with three bedrooms or less: 2 spaces. A residential conversion: 2 spaces per unit of three bedrooms or less

min_lot_sqft.note: Two acres for a detached dwelling, width 250 ft

max_building_coverage.note: 27-403.2 sets 10% for a detached dwelling. The table in 27-305.2A(2) shows 15%. The lower figure is stored. Building coverage counts all buildings on the lot (27-202)

principal_max_height_ft.note: Measured from the finished grade at the front of the building to the mean height of the highest roof surface (27-202 'Building height')

accessory_structure_max_height_ft.note: Any building accessory to a dwelling at the setback line is limited to 14 ft. It may be 1 ft taller for every 2 ft it stands farther from the setback line, up to 25 ft

min_lot_sqft.note: Detached dwelling on an existing tract of four acres or less: 50,000 sq ft, width 150 ft. On a larger existing tract 87,120 sq ft and 250 ft. The figures go by the size of the existing tract, a parcel that held a single-family dwelling when the chapter took effect, not by the size of the lot. For other lots ask the zoning officer

max_building_coverage.note: Building coverage counts all buildings on the lot (27-202). The district sets no impervious figure for a detached dwelling

principal_max_height_ft.note: Measured from the finished grade at the front of the building to the mean height of the highest roof surface (27-202 'Building height')

accessory_structure_max_height_ft.note: Any building accessory to a dwelling at the setback line is limited to 14 ft. It may be 1 ft taller for every 2 ft it stands farther from the setback line, up to 20 ft

value.note: Detached dwelling on an existing tract of four acres or less. The tiers go by the size of the existing tract (a parcel that held a single-family dwelling when the chapter took effect), read here from the lot area

Detached dwelling on an existing tract larger than four acres. The tiers go by the size of the existing tract (a parcel that held a single-family dwelling when the chapter took effect), read here from the lot area
